content.description: Beyond Rockets City is an entire ecosystem of NFTs based on the Cardano Blockchain. Here you can own rooms in the Cardano Tower, own the Shelley Supermarket, houses in the Adaville and many other locations in the city. You can buy items, vehicles, avatars and so much more. The city welcomes you, you belong here. In the crazy world of crypto, we often hear ourselves say “to the moon!!!” to celebrate the rising value of assets we’ve invested in.
content.meta: Find out about Beyond Rockets (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
